name: Shikigi Kiki
source:
"This school is a place to do XR, right? Classes? What's that?"

She is the daughter of the [url=/c113654]chancellor[/url] of Nijou Crane Academy. In other words, she is the [url=/c113636]sensei[/url]'s cousin and acts as his younger sister. She even thinks that she is his real sister. 
She is good at games and came into the academy as a special student for XR. She's basically a hard gamer who just logs into XR. Her enthusiasm can be seen so much that she was given the role of "hero" in the game. But she has already partially destroyed her own knight's chivalric order.... Well, I guess it couldn't be helped. Because this "hero" is the most self-centered person in the world. How can she be a true hero if all she does is play games? 
By the way, she only listens to sensei, whom she regards as her older brother.
Her other trademark is her small body. "It's only because everything else is so big, that you think I'm small" she likes to say.

[b][u]GAME SPEC[/u][/b]
Race: Human
Height: 135 cm
Occupation: Hero
